paragraphs.text: Kyoki (KYO-kee) , Sanity's Eclipse , is a kami of Kamigawa .

Kyoki is a dreaded oni whose very gaze is said to induce insanity. It is worshiped by the ogres of Kamigawa and called many names including the Eater of Minds, the Corrupter of Thoughts, the Bringer of Madness, and the Lord of Fear. They will often chant its various names and offer their blood in an attempt to summon it.
